bbc-6-musics-rave-forever:m0033n8v.desc: On BBC Sounds until 12 Jan. Cruise through the history of an iconic gaming soundtrack, from past to present. Across three decades, GTA Radio's iconic stations have become a definitive time capsule of club culture, curated by some global heavyweights like The Blessed Madonna, Soulwax, Solomun, and Gilles Peterson. Dial into the sounds of Jaydee, Ron Trent, PinkPantheress, Major Lazer, Jayda G, and Todd Terje on a journey spanning Acid House, Techno, Nu-Disco, Hardcore, Trance, Latin Electronic and beyond. A We Are Grape production for BBC 6 Music.

bbc-radio-1s-drum-and-bass-show:m003427m.desc: On BBC Sounds until 15 Dec. Charlie Tee crowns a luscious new Drop of the Week from 1991 and Grace Barton. Plus the excitement is building for Boomtown with the announcement of Noisia as one of the headliners for 2027! Charlie celebrates by playing a classic track from Noisia as her Rave Revival selection, and we hear from A.M.C ahead of an exclusive play of his Boomtown 2026 set. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1.

he164eebcfc1e317e.desc: One year after the release of her twelfth studio album The Life of a Showgirl, Taylor Swift is back with an encore. Specifically, The Encore, four tracks that have polarized critics and Swifties alike, from the country-esque number one hit “Patient Zero” to her ode to married Ohioan bliss, “Cleveland!” For some, the new songs lean into Swift’s worst writing impulses. But for others, including our hosts (and resident Swiftologists) Charlie and Nate, the tracks call back to earlier eras of Swift’s songwriting, and perhaps evoke more nuanced discussion about what it means to release music as the…
